title: Correct reconstruction
statement: A secret-sharing scheme is correct for an access structure if, for every authorized finite set of parties, every secret, and every random input, reconstructing from the shares produced by the sharing map returns the original secret.
hypotheses_covered: For every finite set $A$, if $A$ is authorized, reconstruction of the sharing of every secret using every random input returns that secret
